title: Tonkatsu Sauce
source: Japanese 3 : 3 : 1 home ratio; Just One Cookbook (method)

items.body: Stir the Worcestershire and sugar in the jar until the sugar is fully dissolved and no grains show on the spoon.
Add the ketchup and stir until smooth and evenly brown.
Refrigerate at least 30 min. It thickens as it chills.

nutritionSource: Labels in USDA FoodData Central Branded Foods (Lea & Perrins, Heinz); USDA SR Legacy (sugar, Worcestershire g per tbsp). Yield includes the volume of the dissolved sugar.
notes: Thick and sweet-tangy like Bull-Dog. For Bull-Dog thickness, simmer with 1 tsp cornstarch stirred into 1 tbsp water until glossy, ≈1 min (adds 10 kcal per batch).
Goes on tonkatsu and shredded cabbage. Used in Katsudon.
